summary: Lanao del Sur 2nd District representative with 25 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant bills: an electricity lifeline-rate expansion, travel-tax abolition, an anti-dynasty bill and a violence-against-women-in-politics bill. Only the economic dimension has two distinct issues; the rest are single-issue.
caveat: Economic 0 reflects a subsidy bill against a tax-cut bill, not missing data. Few rubric-relevant bills; no votes reviewed.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Expanded electricity lifeline rate for minimum-wage earners (-2, consumer subsidy) versus travel-tax abolition (+2, tax cut). Thin evidence.
